items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: that was a focus point for a lot of the guys in Buddy’s band, where half of the band were using some hard drugs and so forth. Gene Quill was playing lead alto. Pete Yellin, Jay Cory, Marty Flax, Steve Perlow were the saxophone section you know?

ctx.x: How did you — did you have any ways of dealing with that?

Well I was enjoying what I was doing. I was in my early 20s and spunky you know. And unfortunately there was a lot of drugs in those days and I was doing some of them, so that kept us, that was a focus point for a lot of the guys in Buddy’s band, where half of the band were using some hard drugs and so forth. Gene Quill was playing lead alto. Pete Yellin, Jay Cory, Marty Flax, Steve Perlow were the saxophone section you know? And all five of those guys were using hard drugs plus myself and the bass player and…
Yeah and there was a lot less ways to distract yourself pre cell phone and all that stuff.
